# CI/CD Tools and Practices Final Project

## Project Name
CI/CD Tools and Practices Final Project

## Project Description
This project demonstrates the implementation of Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices using GitHub Actions and Tekton.

## GitHub Actions Workflows
This directory contains the GitHub Actions workflows created as part of the CI/CD Tools and Practices Final Project.

These workflows automate code quality checks, linting, and unit testing to help ensure the reliability of the application.

## Technologies Used
- GitHub
- GitHub Actions
- Tekton
- Python
- flake8
- nose

## Project Objective
The objective of this project is to understand and implement CI/CD workflows, automate testing, and improve software development and delivery practices.
